title: The 'Your workouts are only on this phone' card is not true for gym members or phones with Android backup on
what: After the third workout, a member with no MettleUp account sees a card saying their workouts are only on this phone. But a member who joined a gym has workout sharing with trainers switched on at joining, so the phone sends the gym each workout's day, name, heaviest set per exercise and set count for up to a year. And Android's own backup copies the whole workout record to the member's Google account whenever backup is on in the phone's settings. The card is meant as a warning about losing data, but it tells the member something about where their data is that is wrong.
expected: The card only says the workouts are only on this phone when that is true, or it says plainly what else holds a copy (the gym, if sharing is on; the phone's Google backup, if on).
who: members without a MettleUp account, mostly gym members
how_often: every member who reaches 3 workouts without signing in
fix_line: Reword the card to say that losing this phone loses the workouts, without claiming nowhere else holds them, or give gym members who share a different line.

items.reason: Part 1 of 3: 60 promises (parts 2 and 3 are in L4-phone-lib-core-p2 and -p3). Privacy ones: P-A7-phone-watch-1-43 kept (only the recording and the install number go to our server; the AI service gets the clip only). P-A7-whats-new-2-22 kept (the 18+ and terms tick sits before Google sign-in); the under-18 age gap is the known FN-L4-phone-cloud-backup-ai-02. P-A7-phone-watch-2-20 and 2-23 kept (no code in the plan folder deletes anything when the free month ends; feature behind a switch). P-A7-whats-new-2-95, 2-96, 2-97, 3-08, 2-55, 2-73 kept by the code and the notice. Broken: P-A7-phone-watch-1-46 ('only on this phone') = new FN-L4-phone-lib-core-01. P-A7-phone-watch-1-47 (watch log holds only screen times) = reused FN-A5-phone-lib-core-3-01. P-A7-whats-new-2-45 ('switch on Share my workouts with my trainers') is outdated: joining switches it on with no yes = reused FN-L4-phone-shop-2-03. GAP lines P-A7-whats-new-2-60, 3-04, 3-05, 3-18, 3-19, 3-34 (4 tabs with Progress, now 3 tabs; Later in 3 days; desk workout days; no microphone) are the known old-notes fault, reused FN-A3-whats-new-phone-03; members see only the last 3 updates. Feature-only lines (2-05 to 2-18, 2-21, 2-26 to 2-42, 2-46 to 2-92, 2-99, 3-03, 3-11) hold no personal-data claim beyond those above and are left to hunt 10; not driven on a phone.

Notice exists in English and Hindi and names help, spoken feedback, watch log and crash reports. Consent: the watch screen log is off until switched on (notice says consent). Help and feedback are sent only when the member taps Send (a voluntarily given use fits India's law); crash reports are sent by themselves but are scrubbed on the server and hold no gym or phone details. Children: the 18+ tick sits before Google sign-in; ages 10 to 17 can still be typed (known FN-L4-phone-cloud-backup-ai-02). Breach timing: nothing in this area.

This area only sends help questions, feedback, watch logs and crash reports to MettleUp's feedback box; nothing here reads gym data at MettleUp. Who reads the box and its read log is the HQ side, checked in L4-hq-app. The reply fetch needs a per-question secret, so only the sending phone reads its answers.

E-feedback: the phone keeps its own last 30 questions with answers (no end date, but it is the member's own copy on their phone, cleared by Erase all data). Replies are asked for only for questions from the last 30 days. Server keeping (1 year, crash 90 days) is the HQ side; its gaps are FN-A3-help-02 and FN-L4-hq-app-05, not repeated here. Nothing in this area keeps data longer than promised.

Help questions go to Cloudflare and Claude (named); spoken feedback to Groq (named); crash text to GitHub (named). Not named: help also sends the push address and gym member key (reused FN-A5-phone-lib-core-1-02); the watch log sends more than its line says (reused FN-A5-phone-lib-core-3-01); copies from the GitHub APK ask GitHub for new versions every 6 hours and the What's new file falls back to GitHub, while the notice lists GitHub only for crash text (same fault as the demo films, reused FN-L4-phone-tracker-engine-01); the hidden AI coach keys and phone speech are the known FN-L4-phone-components-1-01. No analytics library and no WhatsApp or Health Connect call in this area.

Erase all data forgets the phone's question list. Help questions on the server are tied to a random install number, not the account, and are kept 1 year as the notice says; the notice does not promise Delete my account removes them, so no broken promise. Server and backup deletion of the account itself is outside this area. A real delete is a live write, not run.
